insights.text: The approved Django REST Framework pull request will be merged once conflict updates are resolved, which will close issue 120.
Whether refactoring the Django backend to split the single API app into multiple domain-specific apps will require complex data and table migrations in the future.
Maintaining a single API app structure is preferred for now to simplify cleaning up the existing backlog.
The reported psycopg2 bug is considered low-hanging fruit that can be resolved by updating the version number.
Juhe Lee will be assigned to conduct the peer review for pull request #197.
